title: Time-Travel Speculation
tagline: Compare rollback-free compensation strategies for speculative execution under branch uncertainty.

curves.label: Shadow Snapshotting
curves.code: function run(n){ let cost=0; let snapshots=[]; for(let i=0;i<n;i++){ snapshots.push(allocSnapshot()); cost+=3; } for(let j=0;j<n;j++){ if(mispredict(j)){ cost+=snapshots[j].size*0.7; restore(snapshots[j]); } } return cost; }
curves.name: Shadow Snapshotting

curves.label: Undo-Log Compensation
curves.code: function run(n){ let cost=0; let undo=[]; for(let i=0;i<n;i++){ undo.push([]); } for(let step=0; step<n; step++){ beginSpec(step,undo[step]); for(let k=0;k<Math.floor(Math.log(step+2)+1);k++){ undo[step].push(recordWrite()); cost+=2; } if(mispredict(step)){ for(let x=undo[step].length-1;x>=0;x--){ applyUndo(undo[step][x]); cost+=1.5; } } } return cost; }
curves.name: Undo-Log Compensation

curves.label: Checkpoint Hopping
curves.code: function run(n){ let cost=0; let stride=Math.max(1, Math.floor(Math.sqrt(n))); for(let cp=0; cp<n; cp+=stride){ createCheckpoint(cp); cost+=12; } for(let step=0; step<n; step++){ if(mispredict(step)){ let cp=Math.floor(step/stride)*stride; cost+=2*(step-cp)+8; restoreCheckpoint(cp); } } return cost; }
curves.name: Checkpoint Hopping

curves.label: State Diff Merging
curves.code: function run(n){ let cost=0; let diffs=[]; for(let i=0;i<n;i++){ diffs[i]=collectStateDiff(i); cost+=1; } for(let step=0; step<n; step++){ if(mispredict(step)){ for(let a=0;a<step;a++){ if(shareDependencies(a,step)){ cost+=0.3; mergeDiff(diffs[a],diffs[step]); } } cost+=7; } } return cost; }
curves.name: State Diff Merging

curves.label: Delta-Only Replay
curves.code: function run(n){ let cost=30; let deltas=[]; for(let i=0;i<n;i++){ deltas.push(generateDelta(i)); cost+=0.4; } for(let step=0; step<n; step++){ if(mispredict(step)){ let m=Math.floor(Math.log(step+2)+1); for(let t=0;t<m;t++){ replayDelta(deltas[step-m+t]); cost+=2.2; } } } return cost; }
curves.name: Delta-Only Replay
